leave_line: No. I've kept my head down for thirty years by knowing when to leave a room. This is that. Goodbye.

took_wisp_essence.line: I felt that from here. Like a scream through a wall. Don't make a habit of it.

released_wisp.line: That's the first kind thing anyone's done at that circle in a very long time.

freed_wisp.line: Off it goes. Good. Somebody should get to leave.

inquisitor_hostile.line: One fewer white coat on the road. I won't pretend I'm sad. I'll pretend I'm surprised, though.

mercy_let_go.line: They're wrong, but they're frightened. Frightened people deserve a door, sometimes.

mercy_cell_fight.line: They were cruel, but they were sick. I hope it was quick.

hollow_wolf_killed.line: Poor thing. There was nothing left in it but the shape.

bandits_cleared.line: Bandits. Well. They never bothered me; I had nothing they could carry.

strongbox_kept.line: Finders keepers. The garrison would say otherwise, which is why we don't ask the garrison.

shrine_rekindled.line: Somebody kept that flame going for a reason. Nice to see it kept.

wolves_cleared.line: The wolves used to sing at night. I'll miss it, a little.

banter.line: You'd think after thirty years the trees would have something new to say. They don't. Neither do I, but I try.
The Lantern Order burned my teacher. They called it a mercy. I called it something else, very quietly, for a very long time.
Glamour isn't lying. It's showing someone what they already wanted to see. Lying is much less work.
You're greyer than you were. I'm not going to scold you. I'm just going to look at you like this.
Do you hear them, at night? No? Good. Don't start.
One lantern in the window facing north. That's all. My gran said that's the way home.
